subject: POC: trial environment & success criteria (hosted vs dedicated vs VPC)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@acmeai.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: POC recap & next steps  environment options (hosted / dedicated / VPC)

Hi Alex 

Thanks for the call this morning  great to meet you and Priya. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on scope and timelines for the proof-of-concept: 

Summary of ask
- Evaluate Redwood inference for document understanding at scale (summary + entity extraction + reranking) across 100k monthly requests.
- Need isolated evaluation for performance and data security requirements (SOC2 + customer-managed keys).

Proposed success criteria (so we can measure POC):
1) Latency: p95 generation latency <= 400ms for 512-token sequences under a sustained 50 qps load.
2) Cost: per-request token cost (estimated) within 20% of current benchmarked baseline.
3) Quality: F1 >= 0.85 on the provided entity extraction test set and summary ROUGE-L improvement over baseline.
4) Reliability: no more than one outage >5 minutes during the 2-week POC window.

Environment options we discussed (tradeoffs):
- Hosted trial (fastest onboarding): Redwood-hosted model endpoints, shared infra. Pros: 1-2 day setup, streaming enabled, built-in telemetry. Cons: data-in-transit to Redwood (we can enable customer-supplied KMS for encryption-at-rest).
- Dedicated sandbox: reserved GPU pool for AcmeAI within Redwood dedicated offering. Pros: predictable throughput, closer to production perf. Cons: 1-2 week provisioning lead time, commitment for reserved capacity during trial.
- VPC trial (private deployment): private control plane + customer VPC peering. Pros: full network isolation, KMS/HSM support, audit logs. Cons: longer onboarding (2-3 weeks), we’ll need your infra and network team involved.

Suggested next steps / owners:
- Acme: confirm top 3 success criteria (Alex / Priya)  due by Tue 2027-05-04.
- Redwood: send SOW + environment setup checklist and a recommended test harness (Marissa)  sent by Wed 2027-05-05.
- Infra kickoff (if VPC): connect Acme infra and Redwood network engineer (Vivek) to scope peering and firewall rules  target week of 2027-05-10.

Attachments: I attached a draft success_criteria doc and a network template for the VPC option.

If hosted looks like it meets your requirements, we can stand up a hosted trial in 48 hours and ship the test harness so your engineers can start validating quality and latency. If you prefer dedicated or VPC, we can provide a timeline and a one-off SOW for trial access.

Thanks  I’ll wait for your confirmation on the criteria and preferred environment.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
---
